public_verification_contract.root_data: Only public production RSA2048 moduli for generations0/1 are embedded as factual verification data; exponent65537. No private/owner key, development-root fallback, ease-restriction policy or runtime trust override
public_verification_contract.certificate: RSA-PSS/SHA256 verifies signature[0x130,0x230) over certificate[0x10,0x130) with the selected public production root; certificate contains ProgramId mask/pattern and certified public modulus[0x30,0x130)
public_verification_contract.NRR: RSA-PSS/SHA256 verifies signature[0x230,0x330) over the complete signed area[0x330,declared_size) with that certified modulus
public_verification_contract.API: SecKeyCreateWithData imports public PKCS#1 DER in memory; SecKeyVerifySignature uses RSASignatureMessagePSSSHA256, MGF1-SHA256 and salt32. CommonCrypto SHA256 records the complete immutable signed-area digest. No keychain persistence or private-key operation occurs in production
public_verification_contract.compatibility_boundary: Pinned Atmosphere accepts variable nonzero PSS salts. This host intentionally supports salt32, confirmed on the genuine local NRR and independent fixtures; other valid encodings are not silently accepted or claimed compatible

structure_and_policy.header: NRR0, supported production key generation, declared size matching snapshot; ProgramId@0x330 equals the compile-time title and matches certificate mask/pattern; User kind0@0x33c
structure_and_policy.hashes: u32 offset@0x340/count@0x344; range starts at/after0x350 and fits without multiplication overflow. Original32-byte hashes must be lexicographically sorted and unique. Authenticated count0 is valid but authorizes no module hash
structure_and_policy.process: A live retained current-process registration is mandatory. Wire PID is not a trusted kernel identity; this in-process transport binds its own getpid as documented by RO_HOST
structure_and_policy.snapshot: Nonzero 4KiB-aligned source address and byte size, no address overflow, at most1MiB diagnostic resource cap. mach_vm_read_overwrite copies the complete readable range before parsing or cryptography; ipc_guest alone is not treated as a readability check
structure_and_policy.registry: Only after complete validation, store original source address/size, owned immutable full snapshot, exact original hash range/count and signed-area SHA256 under the RO mutex. Reject duplicate addresses and registry overflow; at most64 records per service state
structure_and_policy.lifetime: Retained clones/copies share the real registry. Last state release frees every snapshot and unregisters the process. Mutation/free of the caller's original buffer cannot replace the trusted hashes
structure_and_policy.limits_boundary: The1MiB snapshot cap and duplicate-address rejection are explicit host diagnostic policy. The64-entry bound follows the pinned public implementation's MaxNrrInfos; none is a measured game requirement
structure_and_policy.unsupported: Cmd0 MapNro, cmd1 UnmapNro, cmd3 UnregisterModuleInfo, cmd10 alternate registration and unknown methods still stop explicitly. No NRO memory mapping, relocation, AOT execution, symbol/list alias protocol, module initialization or first frame is implied by cmd2 success
